description: This Dart file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget named HomeFragment, which displays a Google Map with interactive features such as location retrieval, reverse geocoding, route drawing, and ride simulation flows including rider approaching, rider arrival, journey progress, and completion. It manages map markers, polylines, user interactions, and UI overlays, capturing core functionalities for the app's 'home' feature related to ride and map interactions.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that acts as the main map-based UI component, managing state for user location, destination, markers, routes, and ride interaction flows.

classes.name: _HomeFragmentState
classes.description: The state class for HomeFragment, encapsulating the core logic for map initialization, location permission handling, reverse geocoding, marker management, route drawing, ride simulation, and UI updates.

methods.name: _HomeFragmentState
methods.description: Constructor initializing the state.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and begins fetching the current location.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up timers and controllers when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: _getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches the user's current geographic location and updates the map and address.

methods.name: _reverseGeocode
methods.description: Converts geographic coordinates into a human-readable address.

methods.name: _initializeMarkers
methods.description: Sets up initial rider markers near the user's location.

methods.name: _buildGoogleMap
methods.description: Constructs the Google Map widget, handling loading failures by presenting a fallback UI.

methods.name: _buildMapFallback
methods.description: Displays a placeholder UI when the Google Maps API fails to load.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Handles camera movement stops to update the center location and reverse geocode.

methods.name: _buildBottomPanel
methods.description: Renders the bottom UI panel with location info, destination entry, distance, and ride controls.

methods.name: _buildRideStatusCard
methods.description: Displays a status message during an active ride.

methods.name: _openLocationSearch
methods.description: Opens the bottom sheet for selecting a destination.

methods.name: _onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Handles destination selection, updates markers, and draws route polyline.

methods.name: _drawRoutePolyline
methods.description: Draws a red polyline route between origin and destination points.

methods.name: _generateRoutePoints
methods.description: Creates intermediate points for a curved route polyline for visual realism.

methods.name: _fitMapToRoute
methods.description: Adjusts camera bounds to encompass both start and end points.

methods.name: _showRideBottomSheet
methods.description: Displays the bottom sheet for ride confirmation.

methods.name: _startRiderApproach
methods.description: Simulates the rider approaching via marker updates over time.

methods.name: _onRiderArrived
methods.description: Handles the rider arriving, prompting the user to start journey.

methods.name: _startJourney
methods.description: Simulates the journey progressing toward the destination with marker updates.

methods.name: _onJourneyComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of the journey, resets state, and navigates to celebrating screen.
